systems.owner: Office National de l'État Civil et de l'Identification (ONECI)
systems.tiers: one commune, Grand-Bassam: over 200,000 records digitised in a 16-day pilot and the storage media handed to the mayor on 8 April 2024; nearly 250 civil status centres said to be open nationally

note: A vendor's account of a civil-registration digitisation pilot in one town hall: an application, logged for the records row. The document states no connection at the town hall; the registers were handed over on storage media.
